svg.title: Phase 5 HDMI and DDC transport block diagram
svg.desc: Orthogonal diagram showing HDMI IN and HDMI OUT at the top, custom hardware in the middle, Raspberry Pi at the bottom, and explicit clean routes for pass-through, DDC, EDID, HPD, and source 5 volt detection.
svg.text: Phase 5 HDMI / DDC Intermediary Transport Concept
Switched DDC ownership with monitor EDID still reachable by the source and controlled HPD behavior
I2C for DDC/CI, GPIO for mux select, HPD sense,
